caption: The drawing depicts three children standing together. The child on the left is a boy wearing a green cap, green shirt, and green pants, holding a basket filled with fruit in one hand and offering an apple with the other. The middle child, facing away from the viewer, wears a red hat, a striped dress with a red bodice, and white stockings. The child on the right is a girl in a cream-colored hat, a yellow dress with red sleeves and trim, green stockings, and brown shoes, with one hand resting on the middle child's shoulder and the other holding a book. The background features large, stylized leaves colored in shades of green, red, and cream, set against a dark, textured backdrop. The ground under the children is patterned with tufts of grass in tan and muted green tones. The drawing has a rectangle with visible edges and is surrounded by a cream-colored border with small, scattered brown spots. There is a signature "Paul Hibbs" on the bottom left of the border.
title: Printed Cotton
